latest_release.name: v1.1.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

> [!WARNING]
> This is the final release that will support Jellyfin 10.10 and 10.11!
> 
> `v1.2.0`, planned for release in December, will [require Jellyfin 12+](https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/discussions/1640)


This release has a lot!

- Improvements & overrides for HDR & Dolby Vision playback
- Support for the optional [companion plugin](https://github.com/damontecres/jellyfin-plugin-wholphin)
- More consistent audio/subtitle track selection between episodes

`v1.1.1` is a quick release to fix a single bug, the majority of changes are from `v1.1.0`.

### New Features & Enhancements
* New user preference to force enable or disable common HDR and Dolby Vision formats by @whitingj in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/1644
* Experimental: Convert Dolby Vision profile 7 to 8.1 on devices without a profile 7 decoder by @SergeiAK in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2017
* Add support for server plugin by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/1384
* Auto-configure Discover from Wholphin server plugin by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2134
* Improve track persistence for series & episodes by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/1802
* Add Fire OS voice command permission for MediaSession by @mirimsees in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2076
* Change max bitrate during playback by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2097
* Can Select Artist or Album Artist to be displayed on Music > Artists Page by @clintjb in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2127
### UI/UX Improvements
* Rename music "Top Rated Unwatched" row to "Top Rated" by @bobberb in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2118
* Update playlist details to match library grid by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2113
* Show album artist under album name on album cards by @bobberb in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2117
* Inherit parent view options and sort for sub-folders by @mizuka123 in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2045
### Bug Fixes
* Fix experimental settings for AC3 surround sound by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2101
* Better handling for Seerr request permissions & minor discover UI tweaks by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2084
* Fix: VLC doesn't restart playback from the beginning as expected by @osipovgleb in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2050
* Fixes to `v1.0.9` by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2072
* Request audio focus for video playback so background music pauses by @hawkinslabdev in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2151
* Allow play/pause from untrusted media controllers by @aalaei in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2145
* Minor bug fix by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2167
* Fix HDHomeRun Live TV direct playback by including the live stream ID by @coulterj in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2163
* Fix adding Seerr server if plugin is not installed by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2179
### Other changes
* Show warning for future unsupported server version by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2115
* Updates to session restoration by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/1905
* Include image tags in item image URLs by @4eh5xitv6787h645ebv in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2031
* Add detected HDR info to debug page by @damontecres in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2140
* Update Kotlin to v2.4.21 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2057
* Update actions/upload-artifact digest to cf430e0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2056
* Update dependency org
